original_gold.body: CurrPage.SaveRecord() is called unconditionally after HandleOnAssistEditSourceTable() in OnAssistEdit. HandleOnAssistEditSourceTable() returns without setting "Source Table No." when the user cancels the lookup, so for a new, unsaved DelayedInsert row the subsequent SaveRecord() forces an insert with "Source Table No." = 0, which immediately raises TableMissingErr -- an unexpected error from a cancel action. Only call SaveRecord() when the field was actually set (e.g. guard on Rec."Source Table No." <> 0).

scope_union_sensitivity.label: Old outputs, old one-to-one assignments, scope changes only. Not a corrected-dataset rescore, complete-fix result, or model-improvement estimate.

comparison_arms.call_volume_limit: 145 entries per arm, once each: 290 root and 5510 serial leaf CLI processes if every plan completes, plus at most 208 entry-level judge processes. CLI processes are not API calls: tool turns, retries and repairs can increase actual model requests. No automatic repeat is authorized.
comparison_arms.dispatch_guard: Wait for coordinator authorization. Dispatch each immutable BC-Bench arm commit with model=gpt-5.6-sol, test-run=false, modified-only=false, repeat=1, and engine-sha equal to that commit's checked-in pin.
comparison_arms.publication_guard: A nonempty engine-sha activates the existing summarize-results mock gate, disabling Braintrust/Kusto/leaderboard publication. It must equal the checked-in engine pin; BCQuality stays transitively pinned.
comparison_arms.version_guard: Install exact npm CLI 1.0.88 under RUNNER_TEMP, resolve its native platform executable, verify its banner with --no-auto-update, and prepend only that native directory to the job PATH. Export COPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE=false to the job and explicitly to evaluation. Both new engine pins forward this optional variable through their cleared child environment. Runtime freezing relies on explicit false plus the isolated native executable, not CI=true and not a wrapper. The engine rejects startup/observed CLI and model identity mismatches.

Real startup initialization accepts 1.0.88 and rejects intentional expected version 1.0.83. Actual BC-Bench installer also verified from a path containing spaces.
